title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：network　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 network 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the engineer ① built the network that no worker in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the building was the whole of the year. The ② network, meaning the web itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a network, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ network in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ network at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A network, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the network was the whole of the matter, meaning the connection and not the web. The ⑥ network, meaning the connection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; network, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a web and a connection. He said the connection is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ network had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ network of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of recording; network, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ network I remember is the web recorded in the manual, which closed in 1985 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ network, my mother said in 1987, is the only web that improves by being recorded; every network, she said, is a connection that has agreed to look like a web. She said the connection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 网络；关系网（指车间里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 网络；关系网（指那张网络本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the network 建立这一张网络
D. n. 网络；关系网（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 网络之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的网络之事）
F. n. 网络；关系网（指说明书里写到、被记载的那一张）
G. n. 网络、联络（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 联络（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the network that no worker in the workshop would have recorded
The network, meaning the web itself and not the lever
the network at the far bench
the network was the whole of the matter
the network had become a line in a manual
The network of the whole thing
A network, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: build the network 意为“建立这一张网络”，1978 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯记载的一张网络做了一遍。
network 意为“网络；关系网”，指那张网络本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
network 意为“网络；关系网”，指车间里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
network 意为“网络；关系网”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
network 意为“网络、联络”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张联络就是那件事的全部。
network 意为“联络”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张网络，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
network 意为“网络；关系网”，指说明书里写到、被记载的那一张，到 1983 年这一张成了说明书里的一行。
network 意为“网络之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的网络之事是一处车间和三个年头的记载。
network 意为“网络；关系网”，我记得的是说明书里记载过的那一张，1985 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一张。
network 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，网络是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的网络。
